craft_notes: Sthāyin: asking resort. Device: end-dash→comma (poise stated softly, haven questioned). Rejected: 'port' for 'haven' — killed: haven kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: O'er sway and ken, past passion, past writ stands prayed-for poise,
sundered from thee, what haven higher for the prayerful?
l4.sanskrit_cite: aiśvaryajñānavairāgyadharmebhyo 'py upari sthitim nātha prārthayamānānāṃ tvad ṛte kā parā gatiḥ

reads_against.argmap: Above even lordship, knowledge, dispassion, dharmas — the standing prayed for.; Without you, O lord, what higher resort for those praying? → No higher resort than you above all attainments.
c1_essence: Past sway, gnosis, dispassion, writs: no loftier haven cut off from you.
reads_against.l2: High past sway and gnosis, past dispassion and writs stands what men pray for — cut off from you, lord, what loftier haven for the praying?
